brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the effect of a 12-week liraglutide treatment as an addition to dietary intervention in comparison to dietary intervention alone on body weight, body composition, ectopic lipid accumulation and insulin sensitivity in subjects with overweight or obesity.
brief_title: The Effect of Liraglutide on Body Weight, Body Composition, Ectopic Lipid Accumulation and Insulin Sensitivity in Subjects With Overweight or Obesity Without Diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age between 18 and 60 years (both inclusive)
* body mass index ≥27 kg/m2
* informed oral and written consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* diabetes diagnosed previously or during screening
* chronic inflammatory diseases
* uncontrolled hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism
* coronary syndromes and heart failure
* malignant neoplasm - current or in the past
* the use of glucose-, weight- and lipid-lowering medications or anti-inflammatory drugs within the past 3 months
* current use of anticoagulative and/or antiplatelet medications
* use of steroids in the past 12 months
* psychiatric disorders and/or current use of antidepressive or antipsychotic medications
* pharmacologic treatment of obesity in the previous 3 months
* chronic kidney or liver failure
* current smoking
* regular high-intensity physical activity
* specific dietary requirements impossible to fit into study plan
* pregnancy and/or breastfeeding
* polycystic ovary syndrome and/or other hormonal disorders, oral contraception, hormone replacement therapy
* alcohol and/or drug abuse
* infections in the previous month - temporary exclusion

official_title: The Effect of Liraglutide as an Adjunct to Dietary Intervention on Body Weight, Body Composition, Ectopic Lipid Accumulation and Insulin Sensitivity in Subjects With Overweight or Obesity Without Diabetes
